settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME_SECONDS
settings.description: The longest lifetime the attester accepts of a piece of evidence: of the whole (exp - iat) when it has an iat, and of what is left (exp - now, with 60 s for a clock behind the issuer's) always; a binding lives as long as its evidence, so this bounds how long a stolen token stays presentable. Production may only shorten it

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, 0 or less, or above 86400 without OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development: issuance answers 500 server_error naming the variable, from the first request

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_REQUIRE_SINGLE_AUDIENCE_EVIDENCE
settings.description: Whether evidence whose aud names more than one party is refused: such evidence is presentable to each of them, so the attester cannot know it was the intended one

when_wrong.detail: Neither true nor false, in any case: issuance answers 500 server_error naming the variable, from the first request
